models.name: entropy weights
models.summary: Each indicator is scaled between its own minimum and maximum, turned into a share of its column, and then weighted by how much its entropy falls short of the maximum.

objectives: give each indicator a weight that reflects how much it varies
constraints: an indicator that never varies gets weight zero
assumptions: a smaller entropy means the indicator tells more
